cases.title: Upload a PDF file over Wi-Fi
cases.description: Verify that a PDF uploaded over Wi-Fi is available in the destination folder and its content remains readable and unchanged.
cases.preconditions:
1. Environment: ENV-001 — Samsung Galaxy S24 FE, Android 16, One UI 8.5, Google Drive 2.26.387.

2. The user is signed in to Google Drive.

3. Wi-Fi is connected and mobile data is disabled.

4. The Google account has sufficient available storage.

5. A readable PDF smaller than 1 MB is stored locally on the device as TC01\_R01\_document.pdf.

6. The destination folder QA-Connectivity-Lab exists and contains no file with that name.

7. The same Google account is accessible through a desktop browser for verification.

8. The current Wi-Fi-only transfer setting is recorded in the execution notes.
cases.postconditions: Keep the uploaded file in the destination folder until evidence collection is complete.

steps.action: Open the local PDF and check its page count and content.
steps.expected_result: The PDF opens correctly. Its page count and content are noted for comparison.

steps.action: Open Google Drive and navigate to QA-Connectivity-Lab.
steps.expected_result: The destination folder opens successfully.

steps.action: Start a file upload and select TC01_R01_document.pdf from local storage.
steps.expected_result: The upload request is accepted without an error.

steps.action: Wait for the upload to finish and observe the app status.
steps.expected_result: The file appears in the destination folder with no pending upload or error indicator.

steps.action: Refresh the destination folder in Google Drive on the desktop browser.
steps.expected_result: Exactly one file named TC01_R01_document.pdf is listed.

steps.action: Open the uploaded PDF on the desktop and compare it with the local original.
steps.expected_result: The PDF opens, and its page count, text and visible content match the original.

cases.title: Attempt to upload a PDF while offline
cases.description: Verify that an upload attempted without connectivity is not incorrectly reported as completed and that the app communicates an offline, pending, or unsuccessful state.
cases.preconditions:
1. Environment: ENV-001 — Samsung Galaxy S24 FE, Android 16, One UI 8.5, Google Drive 2.26.387.

2. The user is signed in to Google Drive.

3. The Google account has sufficient available storage.

4. A readable PDF smaller than 1 MB is stored locally as TC04\_R01\_document.pdf.

5. The destination folder QA-Connectivity-Lab exists and contains no file with that name.

6. No other uploads are pending.

7. The desktop browser has independent internet access and is signed in to the same Google account.

8. The device's initial connectivity and Wi-Fi-only transfer settings are recorded for restoration after the test.
cases.postconditions:
1. Capture the offline status and desktop verification before restoring connectivity.

2. Cancel the pending upload if that option is available.

3. Restore the device's initial connectivity settings.

4. If the upload completes after reconnection, remove only TC04\_R01\_document.pdf from the test folder after evidence collection.

5. Ensure no upload from this case remains pending.

steps.action: While connected, open QA-Connectivity-Lab in the Android app.
steps.expected_result: The destination folder opens successfully.

steps.action: Disable both Wi-Fi and mobile data on the phone. Ensure no alternative internet connection is active.
steps.expected_result: The phone has no active internet connection.

steps.action: Attempt to upload TC04_R01_document.pdf from local storage.
steps.expected_result: The app does not report a successful upload. It indicates that the operation is offline, waiting, pending, or unsuccessful.

steps.action: Observe the app for 30 seconds and record the exact message and upload state.
steps.expected_result: The app does not falsely indicate completion or crash. The operation's incomplete state remains identifiable.

steps.action: Keeping the phone offline, refresh the destination folder in the desktop browser.
steps.expected_result: TC04_R01_document.pdf is not present in the cloud folder.

steps.action: Open the original PDF from local storage on the phone.
steps.expected_result: The original PDF remains available and readable.

cases.title: Recover an in-progress upload after Wi-Fi interruption
cases.description: Verify that an active file upload interrupted by loss of Wi-Fi can be completed after Wi-Fi is restored, without misleading completion status or unexpected duplication.
cases.preconditions:
1. Environment: ENV-001 — Samsung Galaxy S24 FE, Android 16, One UI 8.5, Google Drive 2.26.387.

2. The user is signed in to Google Drive.

3. The Google account has sufficient available storage.

4. A playable MP4 video without personal information is stored locally as TC08\_R01\_video.mp4.

5. The video is large enough for the upload to remain active while Wi-Fi is manually disabled. Start with approximately 20–50 MB and adjust if needed.

6. The destination folder QA-Connectivity-Lab exists and contains no file with that name.

7. No other uploads are pending.

8. Wi-Fi has working internet access. Mobile data is disabled and no alternative internet connection is active.

9. The desktop browser has independent internet access and is signed in to the same Google account.

10. The device's initial connectivity and Wi-Fi-only transfer settings are recorded for restoration after the test.
cases.postconditions:
1. Keep the uploaded file and collected evidence until review is complete.

2. Ensure no upload from this case remains pending.

3. Restore the device's initial connectivity and transfer settings after evidence collection.

steps.action: Open the local video. Record its file size and duration, and check playback at the beginning, middle, and end.
steps.expected_result: The video plays correctly. Reference details are recorded for comparison.

steps.action: Open QA-Connectivity-Lab and start uploading TC08_R01_video.mp4 over Wi-Fi.
steps.expected_result: The app shows that the upload is in progress.

steps.action: While the upload is visibly in progress, disable Wi-Fi. Keep mobile data disabled.
steps.expected_result: Connectivity is interrupted before upload completion.

steps.action: Observe for 30 seconds. Record the upload status and any message displayed.
steps.expected_result: The app does not falsely report successful completion. The incomplete operation remains identifiable, and the app does not crash.

steps.action: Keeping the phone offline, refresh the destination folder in the desktop browser.
steps.expected_result: No complete, downloadable copy of the video is available. If one is available, investigate whether the upload finished before the interruption took effect.

steps.action: Enable Wi-Fi, confirm internet access, and return to Google Drive. Keep mobile data disabled.
steps.expected_result: Wi-Fi connectivity is restored and the app remains usable.

steps.action: Observe whether the upload resumes automatically. If necessary, use an available retry or upload action without creating another active upload. Record the recovery action and approximate time.
steps.expected_result: The upload resumes or can be restarted through a clear user action.

steps.action: Wait for completion, then refresh the destination folder on the desktop.
steps.expected_result: Exactly one file named TC08_R01_video.mp4 is listed, with no pending upload or error indicator in the Android app.

steps.action: Download the uploaded video on the desktop. Compare its size and duration with the original, and check playback at the beginning, middle, and end.
steps.expected_result: File size and duration match the original. The checked sections play without visible or audible corruption.

steps.action: Open the original video on the phone again.
steps.expected_result: The local original remains available and playable.

cases.title: Retry an interrupted upload without creating duplicate files
cases.description: Verify that using an explicit retry action after an interrupted upload results in one complete, readable file in the destination folder.
cases.preconditions:
1. Environment: ENV-001 — Samsung Galaxy S24 FE, Android 16, One UI 8.5, Google Drive 2.26.387.

2. The user is signed in to Google Drive.

3. The Google account has sufficient available storage.

4. A playable MP4 video without personal information is stored locally as TC15\_R01\_video.mp4.

5. The video is large enough to interrupt an active upload. Start with approximately 20–50 MB and adjust if needed.

6. The destination folder QA-Connectivity-Lab exists and contains no file with that name.

7. No other uploads are pending.

8. Wi-Fi is connected with working internet access. Mobile data is disabled and no alternative connection is active.

9. The desktop browser has independent internet access and is signed in to the same Google account.

10. The device's initial connectivity and transfer settings are recorded for restoration after the test.

11. Exercising this case requires the app to expose an explicit retry action for the interrupted upload.
cases.postconditions:
1. Preserve the resulting file or files and evidence until review is complete, including any suspected duplicates.

2. If the case could not proceed, capture the observed recovery behavior before cleanup.

3. Ensure no upload from this case remains pending; cancel it if necessary and available.

4. Restore the device's initial connectivity and transfer settings after evidence collection.
